reviewMethod: All ten actual screenshots opened with view_image; every stored image hash rechecked. No composite or edited images used.

reviewed.label: options-economy
reviewed.observation: The real Options menu displays Économie; this public quality setting is declared in the report. No cadence or clock is forced.

reviewed.label: stairs-lower
reviewed.observation: The three sprites stand at the lower approach; four shallow steps and contact-shadow meshes are clear.

reviewed.label: stairs-middle
reviewed.observation: The squad has advanced onto different steps. Feet and shadows remain attached to their own supports.

reviewed.label: stairs-upper
reviewed.observation: The N7 leader stands on the raised landing; followers occupy the upper stairs. Actual upper export z=-18.8857 confirms the route.

reviewed.label: stairs-returned
reviewed.observation: The leader has descended beyond the lower approach; the followers remain at separate lower/stair positions. Actual returned export z=-13.1765 confirms descent.

reviewed.label: pillar-before
reviewed.observation: The N7 leader is completely hidden by the nearest opaque column, while Kaidan and Ashley remain visible on its left. This label records capture order.

reviewed.label: pillar-behind
reviewed.observation: The N7 leader is visible to the right of the column; Kaidan is occluded and Ashley remains to its left. No body fragments show through the solid column face.

reviewed.label: pillar-emerged
reviewed.observation: A squad sprite is masked by the column while partial bodies remain at its left/right edges, demonstrating local geometry depth rather than a blanket character visibility toggle.

reviewed.label: camera-threshold-stop
reviewed.observation: The actual x19.5882 export crosses the x18.75 camera clamp. Architecture framing is settled after stopping; a column correctly masks part of the squad.

reviewed.label: camera-threshold-stationary
reviewed.observation: Architecture framing matches the stopped view and the actual player position is identical. No oscillation is visible; native threshold tests separately measure convergence at both signs and several dt values.

scope: Public Citadel stair ascent/descent, opaque-column sprite occlusion and stationary positive camera clamp. Native tests separately verify actual support coordinates, contact shadows under biotic lift and both camera thresholds.
limitations: Representative functional scene and Economy quality; no full artistic or original floor-plan fidelity certificate.
No hardware FPS, Electron or Windows verification.
No retreat/re-engagement boundary claim; QA-fuite-et-reentree remains partial.
Production verification follows registry/workbook generation and is still pending.
